extension.summary: Live map screensaver: flights, satellites, weather, traffic and transit
extension.description: A screensaver that shows a live map of a place you choose, inspired by God's Eye View. Pick the location, zoom and base map (street, dark, satellite or NASA's daily satellite image), then turn on layers: flights, military aircraft, satellites overhead, earthquakes, tropical storms, rain radar, infrared clouds, lightning, rail and subway lines, live transit vehicles and traffic (free TomTom key). No account needed for most layers.
extension.disclaimer: Data comes from public sources (adsb.lol, OpenSky Network, CelesTrak, USGS, NOAA, NASA GIBS, OpenRailwayMap, transit agencies, TomTom). Map tiles © OpenStreetMap contributors / CARTO / Esri. For personal use; follow each provider's terms.
